answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, since the signal funding graph is rebuilt from the meadow history every epoch. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 130 bonds yet holds one position, and the nebula report publishes the merged exposure. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 130 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
